g.text: Toggle Focus Mode -- hides the board + stats, keeps Active
Open the AI assistant panel (auto-enters Focus Mode) -- pick Claude Code,
a local Ollama model, or Claude/ChatGPT/Gemini via API
Add a new field (category) -- writes to goals.json, live-reloads
Set up a plan -- a short Q&A, then hands a crafted prompt to the AI panel
Save the AI panel's transcript to a file -- a memory.md workaround for
Toggle the optional Practice Lab column in Focus Mode -- language picker,
Paste a Spotify playlist/album/track link and play it
